name: How do I choose the best restoration company for a hidden water leak?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best restoration company for a hidden water leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a restoration company for a hidden water leak, look for certifications like those from the IICRC (Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification), which indicates expertise and adherence to industry standards. Prioritize companies with a proven track record, positive customer reviews, and 24/7 emergency services. Ensure they offer comprehensive services, including leak detection, water extraction, drying, mold remediation, and reconstruction, and that they work with insurance companies. Obtain a detailed estimate before committing.
